title: Oil Tanker Struck by Mine in Strait of Hormuz, IRGC Navy Reports
detail: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy reported that an oil tanker struck a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, introducing mine warfare as a significant new dimension of the ongoing crisis. The incident marks a dangerous escalation beyond blockade enforcement, threatening all commercial shipping transiting the strait regardless of flag or affiliation, and raising insurance and transit costs further.
